messages.text: When will bs-1 be available for purchase?
Handed to the team · No restock date available for the BS-1 and I will not guess one.

Right now the BS-1 is showing sold out in both Black and White at $229, and I don't have a restock date I'd trust, so I'm not going to guess one. Georges is checking with Bitfortun and will come straight into this chat with the date, so stay with me here. If you step away, it comes to your email.

In the meantime, tell me your budget and where it'll run, and I'll point you at what's actually on the shelf today.
